_comment: City of Palm Springs — Procurement Helper Configuration
_note: All dollar amounts are in USD. Edit this file to update thresholds city-wide.

ai._comment: AI model settings. Update model here to change across the entire application.

bid_thresholds._comment: Amounts AT OR ABOVE these values require competitive bidding

procurement_methods._comment: Threshold tiers defining the required procurement method per item type

supplies.process: One quote or negotiated purchase. P-Card eligible if under card limit.
Obtain minimum three written quotes. No formal bid required.
Formal competitive bidding process required. Procurement will manage.

equipment.process: Formal competitive bidding required. Procurement will manage.

it_equipment.process: Note: IT equipment is prohibited on P-Card.
Three written quotes. IT Director approval required.
Formal competitive bidding required. IT and Procurement approval.

it_software.process: Note: IT software is prohibited on P-Card.
Three quotes required. IT Director approval.
Formal process required. Procurement will manage.

maintenance_services.process: One quote or negotiated purchase. P-Card eligible if under card limit. No insurance certificate required for routine maintenance.
Three written quotes required. Vendor quote and basic service agreement sufficient.
Formal competitive bidding required. Procurement will manage.

professional_services.process: One quote. Service contract and insurance certificate required.
Three quotes. Contract and insurance required. Not P-Card eligible.
Formal qualifications-based selection. Procurement will manage.

construction.process: City forces or negotiated contract allowed.
Informal bidding procedures per California UPCCAA.
Full formal bidding required per Public Contract Code.

travel.process: City Manager approval required for P-Card travel use. Per diem limits apply.

other.process: Formal competitive process required. Procurement will manage.

signing_authority._comment: Approval required based on contract amount and project type
signing_authority._note: non_public = standard contracts, public = public works / construction

attorney_review._comment: Controls when City Attorney review is required
attorney_review._note: phase2_app_generated_threshold: set a dollar amount when phase 2 is built to bypass attorney review for app-generated contracts below that amount. null = always required.

pcard._note: single_transaction_limit is the default per-transaction cap. Individual card limits may differ.

federal_funds._comment: Micro-purchase thresholds when federal funds are involved (2 CFR 200.320)

sla_days._comment: Default SLA in business days per workflow stage. 0 = no SLA.

rfq_document_thresholds._comment: Which document type is appropriate at which dollar amount

mail._comment: Outbound email (Zoho SMTP). Set smtp_password via SMTP_PASSWORD env var — never store passwords here.

faa._comment: FAA-governed purchase rules — applies to AIP-funded or FAA-regulated airport purchases

requirements.buy_american: Buy American provisions apply (49 U.S.C. § 50101). Materials and equipment must be produced in the U.S. unless an FAA waiver is obtained. Be sure to verify this and prepare appropriate waivers if required.
requirements.dbe: Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) participation goals apply (49 CFR Part 26). Contact Procurement for current DBE goal percentage.
requirements.contract_clauses: FAA mandatory contract provisions and certifications must be included in all contracts (AC 150/5370-10).
requirements.independent_estimate: An independent fee or cost estimate is required for professional services contracts.
requirements.faa_approval: Certain capital expenditures may require FAA pre-approval. Confirm with Airport Administration before proceeding.

city._comment: City-specific defaults used in document generation
city.name: City of Palm Springs

document_types._comment: Attachment document types. Delete only if no attachments use the type.

stage_gates._comment: Required document types before a stage can be advanced. Empty list = no gate.
